faqs.question: What stamps does Dhruv EPC hold for pressure vessel fabrication?
faqs.answer: The Manjusar works holds ASME U and U2 Certificates of Authorization and IBR approval — covering ASME Section VIII Division 1 and Division 2 pressure vessels including IBR-governed boiler-quality equipment.

faqs.question: What types of pressure vessels do you fabricate?
faqs.answer: Separators (two- and three-phase), fixed-bed reactors, distillation columns, accumulators, reflux drums, knock-out drums and surge vessels — horizontal and vertical orientations — to ASME Sec. VIII Div. 1 & 2.

faqs.question: Which materials of construction are available for pressure vessels?
faqs.answer: Carbon steel, low-temperature carbon steel (LTCS), low alloy steels (1.25Cr through 2.25Cr), austenitic stainless steel (304/316/321), duplex stainless steel, high-nickel alloys, and clad plate (stainless or duplex over carbon steel backing).

faqs.question: Which third-party inspection agencies have inspected your pressure vessel jobs?
faqs.answer: Jobs have been executed under Lloyd's Register (LRS), Bureau Veritas (BV), DNV and the statutory agency IBR — the same agency portfolio as the heat exchanger and IBR-vessel business.

faqs.question: What sectors do you supply pressure vessels to?
faqs.answer: Oil & gas, refineries & petrochemicals, fertilizers, power & energy, and the steel industry — from the Manjusar GIDC works at Vadodara, Gujarat.
